snippet.title: xPetu
snippet.description:
Hi, I'm Petu and I enjoy playing and teaching League of Legends. I'm 20 years old and currently studying applied physics and mathematics in Finland. I started making montages and guides for League back in 2015. I hope you enjoy videos and my streams! I enjoy running, playing basketball and disc golf, among other sports. If you have any questions, you can hit me up on Twitter or ask me on stream! I try to read every comment on YouTube but don't be sad if I don't respond. It probably just means that I'm really busy at the time. I really appreciate you caring enough to read this description!

PEAK RANKS
- Rank 10 (Early Season 2020, EUW )
- 934 LP (Mid-Season 2020, EUW )
- 1100 LP, Rank 3 (Season 7, EUNE )

SHEN
- Over 1 500 000 mastery points
- Rank 1 Shen S7/S8/S9
- In-Depth Guide: https://youtu.be/mRkLkMe8GRo

END OF SEASON RANKS
- S9 Challenger 653LP EUW
- S8 Challenger EUNE + EUW Master
- S7 Challenger 1008 LP EUNE (Rank 5)
- S6 Diamond 1
- S5 Diamond 5
- S4 Platinum
- S3 Silver
